description: This script automates the process of creating Liquibase database snapshots for OpenMRS, including cleaning old snapshots, generating new changelogs, and providing usage instructions.

methods.name: build_openmrs_liquibase
methods.description: Builds the OpenMRS Liquibase library by running 'mvn clean install'.

methods.name: delete_snapshots
methods.description: Deletes old Liquibase snapshots from the snapshots directory.

methods.name: create_snapshots
methods.description: Creates new Liquibase snapshots with specified username and password.

methods.name: echo_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.
